splined_shaft.label: 01 · Splined Input Shaft & Coupling
splined_shaft.description: Machined multi-spline vertical input shaft and claw coupling that receives high-torque rotational power from the electric motor above.

mounting_bracket.description: Heavy-duty upper pedestal housing with machined grey triangular gusset ribs, open coupling window, and bolted lower mounting flange.

vertical_drive_shaft.description: Vertical transmission shaft with cylindrical roller bearings and upper spiral bevel pinion driving the horizontal propeller gear.

tunnel_casing.label: 04 · Thruster Tunnel Casing (Cutaway)
tunnel_casing.description: Heavy cylindrical hull penetration duct guiding transverse water flow across the vessel bow. Features top mounting flange and inspection port.

gear_pod.label: 05 · Right-Angle Gear Pod
gear_pod.description: Hydrodynamically streamlined central hub casing enclosing the 90° bevel gearbox, lubricating oil sump, and propeller shaft thrust bearings.

internal_bevel_gears.label: 06 · Internal Bevel Gears & Prop Shaft
internal_bevel_gears.description: Matched spiral bevel ring gear and horizontal drive shaft converting vertical motor RPM to horizontal propeller rotation.

propeller_bearing.label: 07 · Propeller Thrust Bearing & Seal
propeller_bearing.description: Tapered roller thrust bearing assembly with triple lip seals preventing seawater ingress into the gear pod lubricating oil reservoir.

propeller_blades.label: 08 · 4-Blade Skewed Kaplan Propeller
propeller_blades.description: Four high-skew Kaplan bronze propeller blades optimized for maximum thrust efficiency and minimum cavitation noise inside the circular tunnel.

propeller_hub.label: 09 · Propeller Boss / Hub
propeller_hub.description: Heavy central hub boss keyed to the horizontal shaft taper, transmitting torque to the individual Kaplan propeller blades.

cap_fasteners.label: 10 · Fairing Cap, Lock Nut & Fasteners
cap_fasteners.description: Conical hydrodynamic fairing nose cap, threaded shaft lock nut, safety split pin, and perimeter socket-head clamping bolts.

electric_motor.label: 11 · Vertical Marine Electric Drive Motor
electric_motor.material: Cast Iron TEFC Frame / VPI Stator
electric_motor.description: 440 V / 6.6 kV vertical-flange induction motor mounted on top of the thruster well, delivering high starting torque.
